warnings.message: No repository evidence proves an exact existing production developer UUID; raw developer identity is preserved and developer_id remains NULL.
No repository evidence proves an exact existing production location UUID; raw location identity is preserved and location_id remains NULL.
No source-backed latitude/longitude was published in either official source; coordinates remain NULL.
Neither official source states a freehold / foreign-quota / leasehold position for this project; ownership_type remains NULL.

The official brochure states an expected completion of approximately September 2568 BE (September 2025) with no day, and the channel announced ready-for-occupancy on 2025-12-08. No exact completion date is published, so completion_date remains NULL while construction_status is set to Completed.
No payment schedule or payment terms are published in either official source; the Drive folders '016_Payment Account' and '017_Document' are empty. No payment terms are recorded.

The official price list enumerates AVAILABLE units only (63 rows). The project total is 637 residential units, so the remaining 574 units are not enumerated by any official source and were deliberately NOT created.

Unit I501 is listed Available in the current price list (effective 2026-05-22) but the channel posted 'SOLD I501' on 2026-06-26. The newer official Telegram statement wins, so I501 is recorded as sold.

Unit I501 was announced SOLD twice by the official channel: 2025-10-10 and again 2026-06-26, while remaining listed as Available in price lists between those dates. Both statements are preserved; no reservation history is inferred.

Telegram message 712 is titled 'LEB - Master Plan_Price List Part 2 V.3 - updated 12.02 (2).pdf' but its bytes are identical (same SHA-256) to message 714, which is the price list 'LEB - Price List V.3. - Updated 28.03.26.pdf'. Message 712 is therefore treated as a mislabelled repost of the price list, not as a master plan, and is recorded as superseded.

Some price-list areas fall outside the unit-type size bands printed in the official factsheet and brochure (for example Studio 37.10 sq.m against a 31-36 band, One Bedroom Legend 49.75-49.85 sq.m against a 51-60 band, and Two Bedroom Legend 97.10 sq.m against an 87-94 band). Both official values are preserved exactly as published; neither was adjusted.

The factsheet and brochure state a project area of 15-1-29.8 rais (24,519 sq.m.) while the Thai legal disclosure on the brochure's final page states approximately 15 rai 1 ngan 10.10 sq.wa. Both official figures are recorded; neither is treated as corrected.

Drive factsheet page 'Project_Detail_004' still presents the project status as EIA approved / permits approved / construction starting, and the brochure's legal page still reads 'currently applying for construction permit'. The channel's 2025-12-08 ready-for-occupancy announcement and the official source index label 'READY TO MOVE!' are newer and were used for construction_status.

Drive folder '015_Living Service' contains files named 'The Title Heritage_Living Service ...', which belong to a different The Title project. They were excluded from Legendary facts and no living-service claim was extracted.
The official price list is marked '(Internal Use Only)'. Prices are recorded for this unpublished Draft only; the project remains unpublished (publish=false) and no media or public rows were created.
Per-building unit counts are not published by either official source; buildings carry only the source-backed building code and the 7-storey count. units_count remains unset for all 9 buildings.
